title.zh: 节肢动物来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Arthropoda to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开节肢动物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 有争议的晚泥盆世节肢动物（原被解释为昆虫）出现窗口

description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的有争议的晚泥盆世节肢动物（原被解释为昆虫）时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 甲壳类与昆虫证据比较

description.en: Compare Strudiella and Cretophasmomima melanogramma through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较Strudiella 与 Cretophasmomima melanogramma；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: Tokummia katalepsis 大理石峡谷标本地点

description.en: Open the 508 Ma Marble Canyon map point to inspect the linked Tokummia katalepsis specimen sample and its appendage evidence.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 508 Ma 的大理石峡谷点位，检查关联的 Tokummia katalepsis 标本样本及其附肢证据。

limitations: The 508 Ma point is a Marble Canyon locality sample, not a global species range or a mandibulate origin date. Scored appendages are preserved in the named specimens, whereas stem-mandibulate recovery is a morphology-matrix interpretation; neither establishes direct ancestry or complete distribution.

title.en: Waptia fieldensis Burgess Shale specimen series
title.zh: Waptia fieldensis 伯吉斯页岩标本系列

description.en: Open the 508 Ma Burgess Shale map point to inspect the linked Waptia fieldensis specimen series and mandible evidence.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 508 Ma 的伯吉斯页岩点位，检查关联的 Waptia fieldensis 标本系列及其大颚证据。

limitations: The 508 Ma point bounds the Burgess Shale specimen series, not a global Waptia duration or a pancrustacean crown age. The figured specimen series and mouthparts are observations; pancrustacean placement and swimming-predator ecology are topology and functional interpretations, not observed behavior or direct ancestry.

title.en: Yicaris dianensis Yu'anshan Formation developmental series
title.zh: Yicaris dianensis 玉案山组发育系列

description.en: Open the 521–514 Ma Yu'anshan Formation window to inspect the linked Yicaris dianensis growth-stage sample and limb evidence.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 521–514 Ma 的玉案山组窗口，检查关联的 Yicaris dianensis 生长阶段样本及其附肢证据。

limitations: The 521–514 Ma interval is a broad Yu'anshan Formation context for the developmental sample, not a global Yicaris duration or a eucrustacean first-appearance date. Phosphatized growth-stage anatomy is directly preserved, while epipodite homology and crown-eucrustacean placement are character interpretations sensitive to preservation and sampling.

title.zh: Luprisca incuba 奥陶纪育幼窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 450 Ma Upper Ordovician Katian Lorraine Group window in New York to inspect the source-linked Luprisca incuba ostracod material, pyritized appendages and embryos.
description.zh: 在纽约州约 4.50 亿年前的上奥陶统凯迪期洛兰群窗口中打开地图，检查带来源关联的 Luprisca incuba 介形虫材料、黄铁矿化附肢与胚胎。

limitations: The rounded 450 Ma age follows the Upper Ordovician Lorraine Group sample, including Beecher’s Trilobite Bed, rather than a direct numerical date for every carapace, an Ostracoda origin or a global FAD/LAD.

YPM 307300 (holotype) and three additional carapaces preserve pyritized soft parts and embryos as observations; Luprisca incuba placement and the inference of long-lived ostracod brood care remain source-bounded anatomical and taphonomic interpretations, not direct ancestry or unchanged behaviour.
Map markers show the bounded New York occurrence context and PBDB sampling, not complete distribution, abundance, ecology or exact specimen-to-map co-location.

title.zh: Waukartus muscularis 沃基肖化石库窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 437 Ma Brandon Bridge Formation window near Milwaukee to inspect the source-linked Waukartus muscularis holotype and its preserved limbs, muscles and endoskeleton.
description.zh: 在密尔沃基附近约 4.37 亿年前的布兰登桥组窗口中打开地图，检查带来源关联的 Waukartus muscularis 正模及其保存的附肢、肌肉与内骨骼。

limitations: The 437 Ma route rounds the 436.2–437.4 Ma Pterospathodus eopennatus conodont-zone age of the Brandon Bridge Formation sample; it is a locality-and-horizon anchor, not a crown-Myriapoda origin or global FAD.

Holotype UWGM 7595a,b plus 34 additional specimens directly preserve segmented uniramous limbs, muscle remnants and endoskeletal traces; parsimony and Bayesian placement just stemward of crown Myriapoda is a model-dependent topology result, not a direct ancestor.

A marine, substrate-walking life habit is reconstructed from the Waukesha Lagerstätte context and limb morphology, not observed behaviour. The map is sampled occurrence context and does not establish complete distribution, terrestrialization timing or exact specimen-to-map co-location.

title.en: Saxonagrion minutus Upper Permian wing window
title.zh: Saxonagrion minutus 二叠纪晚期翅脉窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 268 Ma Upper Permian Salagou Formation window in the Lodève Basin to inspect the source-linked Saxonagrion minutus wing and its Panodonata attribution.
description.zh: 在洛代沃盆地约 2.68 亿年前的上二叠统萨拉古组窗口中打开地图，检查带来源关联的 Saxonagrion minutus 翅及其 Panodonata 归属。

limitations: The rounded 268 Ma edge is the earliest fossil recognized as a modern odonate in the reviewed sample, not the origin or global FAD of Odonata or a complete lineage duration.

Preserved forewing venation is the direct observation, while the Panodonata attribution is a morphology-based interpretation; the separate 478-locus, 136-species living sample is a topology result and does not turn the fossil into a direct ancestor or modelled age.
Map markers show the bounded French formation and occurrence context, not complete distribution, ecological behaviour, abundance or exact specimen-to-map co-location.

title.zh: Parhyale 附肢图式与翅同源窗口

description.en: Use 0 Ma as present-day navigation context and read the linked evidence from Parhyale hawaiensis CRISPR knockouts and comparative insect expression data testing proximal limb and wing homology.
description.zh: 以 0 Ma 作为现生导航背景，阅读关联的 Parhyale hawaiensis CRISPR 敲除及昆虫表达比较证据，了解近端附肢与翅同源模型的检验。

limitations: Parhyale hawaiensis and the comparative insect material are present-day laboratory and expression datasets; age 0 marks the experiment, not a fossil occurrence, an ancestral date or a global insect origin.

CRISPR phenotypes and expression domains support a testable developmental correspondence between proximal crustacean leg segments and insect body-wall or wing structures, but they do not preserve the first wing or identify one uniquely ancestral fossil precursor.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.

title.zh: 宾夕法尼亚世真变态类昆虫化石样本窗口

description.en: Use the 315–299 Ma composite window as generic map context and read the linked descriptions of five eumetabolan fossils from French and Russian localities, including stem beetle, larval, hymenopterid, hemipteran and psocodean material.
description.zh: 以 315–299 Ma 复合窗口作为一般地图背景，阅读关联文献中来自法国与俄罗斯地点的五件真变态类昆虫化石描述，包括鞘翅目干群、幼虫、膜翅目干群、半翅目和啮虫目材料。

limitations: The five fossils come from multiple Moscovian and Gzhelian localities in France and Russia; 315–299 Ma is a composite sample envelope, not one lineage range, synchronous origin or direct specimen date.

Descriptions and matrix placements distinguish stem coleopterid, holometabolous larval, stem hymenopterid, hemipteran and psocodean material, but these sampled branches do not establish exact crown-order FADs or a single cause for later radiation.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.

title.zh: Cretophasmomima 义县组翅纹拟叶窗口

description.en: Use the source-reported 130–122 Ma interval as generic map context and read the linked study of three Yixian Formation Cretophasmomima melanogramma specimens and their proposed comparison with the leaf-shaped Membranifolia organ.
description.zh: 以来源报道的 130–122 Ma 区间作为一般地图背景，阅读关联研究中三件义县组 Cretophasmomima melanogramma 标本及其与叶形 Membranifolia 器官的拟叶比较假说。

limitations: One female and two male specimens are reported from the Yixian Formation; 130–122 Ma converts the cited approximately 126 ± 4 Ma formation age and is not a global species range or phasmatodean origin date.

Dark wing veins and the comparison with a contemporaneous leaf-shaped plant organ are observations and a proposed functional model. The fossil does not directly measure predator avoidance, feeding behaviour or crypsis performance.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.
